attr.title: Jump King
attr.desc: Take up the challenge and face true high-stakes platforming in Jump King! Struggle upwards in search of the Smoking Hot Babe of legend, but explore with care; a single missed jump could lead to a long fall back down...
attr.inst: Buy Jump King on GOG (DRM-free), version 1.06, and copy a spare copy of your GOG game folder (JumpKing.exe and Content/) into the gamedata folder. The first launch converts textures in Content in place, so do not use your only copy. Steam copies are not supported. See the README for details.
